draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package only reports exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds) with F1 means and seed spread. There is no perturbation/label-noise condition, no robustness criterion applied, and no statistical tests. The claim about robustness to label noise has no supporting evidence.
